Alphabet tanks nearly 13% for worst day ever, losing $500 billion in value
Alphabet shares plunged ... dropping 13% on Thursday, wiping out roughly $500 billion in market cap.
"The strong growth in AI mode queries had an impact because of the lower monetization we are seeing in AI mode," Philipp Schindler, Google's chief business officer, said.
